notes.title: 2024/12/05 Update: NEW Chinese Support Added!
notes.notes:
UPDATE NOTES
Following the addition of new Simplified and Traditional Chinese translations to Eden's Ritter - Paladins of Ecstasy on Sept. 30, 2024, both languages are now also available in Eden's Ritter 1:2 - Priestess of Pleasure. To access them, please switch your game language via the Steam library.

HOW TO SWITCH LANGUAGES
1. Right-click the game in your Steam Library.
2. Select "Properties" in the drop-down menu that appears.
3. In the "General" tab, select the "Language" of your choice from the drop-down menu. The available options should be "English", "Simplified Chinese", and "Traditional Chinese".
4. After you switch the game's language, the game will automatically update to your new preference.

* Please note that save data compatibility is not guaranteed between versions. Switching languages is known to cause temporary font display issues immediately after loading a save from another language.
